description: Real galaxies around us in 3D, glowing by luminosity: the Local Group to scale (McConnachie's catalogue, each distance's error drawn along the line of sight), then the 869 galaxies of Karachentsev's Updated Nearby Galaxy Catalog within ~11 Mpc and 12,000 galaxies of the 2MASS Redshift Survey out to ~80 Mpc, live from NASA's HEASARC, on a log or linear scale, in Galactic or supergalactic coordinates, with Virgo, Fornax, the Norma Cluster at the Great Attractor, the Local Void and Laniakea. Hover a galaxy for its distance, how it was measured and the method's error; click for NED. Caveat: errors grow with distance (TRGB ~5%, Tully–Fisher 20–25%), beyond 11 Mpc the distances are velocity / H0 (a redshift distance, not a measured one), and the Zone of Avoidance behind the Milky Way's plane is empty by selection. Next: our neighbourhood in the Milky Way.
name: The local universe in 3D
